attention_geometry_followup.scope: Narrow source-only follow-up on actual Pro Q/K576 and V512 interfaces and CKV/KPE page authority. No compile, native run, download, source modification, new executor or expanded validation matrix.
attention_geometry_followup.decision: No missing public unequal-depth SDPA/MLA primitive was established. Use existing ordinary SDPA for the current sparse Gather implementation, or the existing typed PagedMlaAttention/RaggedMlaAttention when carrying a compact physical cache. Do not pass Pro576/512 to generic FlashInfer batch qualification; its separate native MLA path is the applicable CUDA implementation.

fixed_model_source.fact: attn_mqa has head_size=kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim, one KV head, v_head_dim=kv_lora_rank. Thus K576/V512 is the intended original absorbed interface, not a padded value tensor.

Q is split into NoPE and PE; the absorbed query is produced by W_kc BMM. Attention receives CKV as values and KPE separately or concatenates [q_nope_out,q_pe] and [k_nope,k_pe]. Model H/NoPE/RoPE geometry remains distinct from indexer dimensions.

public_contracts.contract: ScaledDotProductAttention requires Q-depth==K-depth, equal K/V sequence+heads, and one floating dtype; output last dimension is value.dimensions()[3]. It does not require K-depth==V-depth. Both BSHD and BHSD are explicit.

BatchCapacity has separate qk_head_dim/value_head_dim. MlaCacheLayout::kCkv512Rope64 describes one [CKV512,KPE64] physical row; V is the CKV prefix of that same row and shares scalar cache interpretation.

mla_batch_capacity maps kCkv512Rope64 to QK576,V512,KVheads1 and sets both storage interpretations equal. batch_cache_description(schema,role) only accepts kMla for compact MLA, rejecting independent kKey/kValue arena identities. Packed output depth is512.

Existing compute and ordinary Graph typed MLA nodes use Q+one compact cache (plus owned metadata in compute form), not an artificial third V allocation. Generic Ragged/Paged nodes still use independent K/V ports; the shared-cache distinction is part of schema identity.

ordinary_sdpa.support: Source-admits F32/F16/BF16 resident rank4 attention with independent positive K and V depths and no explicit mask. Native flash or original F32 QK/softmax/PV path has independent value width. This is source support, not a Pro end-to-end numerical run.

typed_ragged_paged_mla.support: Explicit576/512 high-dimensional plain or uniform E4 domain; Q/output same F16/BF16, coherent host resource. MLA requires KVhead1 and a shared cache. value_description creates [1,rows,1,512] using original576-wide K byte strides and run binds V to the same original cache input; no cache expansion/second payload.
typed_ragged_paged_mla.native: Original ggml flash op is tagged boxed for unequal K/V paged read. third_party/ggml_cpu_runtime/patches.json /files/10/edits/7 and /32 preserve logical page mapping/causal/window/E4 interpretation. Native compile also verifies actual direct KV/page readers and bounded workspace.

ordinary_sdpa.support: The absorbed576/512 exception is specifically dense/plain F32, Qheads64 or96, KVhead1, BSHD, F32 accumulation and matching output[B,Q,H,512]. None or additive mask; causalKV>=Q and score-index bounds checked. BF16/F16 general unequal576/512 is not admitted by this ordinary ggml-CUDA exception. Explicit F32 widening of actual BF16 boundaries is the current consumer-compatible path.
ordinary_sdpa.execution: Original full-F32 QK MatMul + scale/mask + softmax + PV MatMul, optional query tiling. The pinned native flash has narrower accumulation on SM89, so this route intentionally does not claim fused MLA or identical performance.

generic_batch_limit.support: qualify_batch only accepts equal dimensions or QK64/V128 (and512/512 plain highdim). Generic RaggedAttention/PagedAttention does not admit Pro576/512.

typed_mla.support: The separate already-registered MLA path explicitly admits576/512 for matching F16 or BF16 plain cache, or BF16 Q/output with one fixed-scale E4 cache, KVhead1, full causal/noncausal (window_left=-1), positive finite scale; no allow_bf16_partials. Native integer/scheduler/workspace bounds still apply.
typed_mla.execution: run_typed<Q,KV,64> uses q_nope512+q_pe64 and ckv512+kpe64, all physical row/head/page strides576; output stride512. V is native CKV, not an independent cache. Both linear ragged and paged original FlashInfer MLA scheduling exist.
typed_mla.qualification_note: native_batch.h:16-18 BF16-partial256 condition applies only to the optional generic partials optimization, not to the distinct native_mla.cu support domain.

ordinary_sdpa.support: Ordinary lowering keeps independent V width and delegates to the MLX selector. The ordinary native fused selector does not treat576/512 as its normal vector/tile specialization; unqualified fused shapes use math QK/softmax/PV (possibly query-blocked). Do not claim generic ordinary fused576 support.

typed_ragged_paged_mla.support: Explicit QK512/576,V512, matching F16/BF16 Q/output and same-type plain storage or same-scale compact E4. The actual patched private hyle_cache_attention and Metal highdim_cache branch handle576/512, including Q1 by compact Steel tile8 rather than unsupported ordinary vector specialization.
typed_ragged_paged_mla.shared_pitch: Both paged and ragged lowerings slice V512 from the original576-wide key root, preserving sequence byte pitch. Page16/private kernel uses separate actual K/V strides. Page metadata/layout/native-use owners remain retained; this review did not inspect or run a new remote binary.

ordinary_sdpa.support: Source-admits the dense/resident F32 absorbed576/512 exception for64/96Qheads, KVhead1, BSHD,no mask,F32 accumulation. The unequal high-dimensional branch executes original F32 MatMul/softmax/MatMul, not the equal64/128/256 native ordinary flash branch. Ordinary BF16 is not admitted here.

typed_ragged_paged_mla.support: Explicit plain F16/BF16 or compact uniform E4 QK576,V512. Route output may be F16 or BF16 independently. Paged uses page_size16. typed_ragged_paged_mla.native_guard: Pinned ggml-Vulkan native admission contains highdim_plain576/512 and highdim_E4 guards; E4 additionally checks same view_src/view_offs, one KVhead, equal row pitches576 and scale identity. This is stronger than accepting descriptors alone and does not assert Pro payload/performance qualification.
